The official Tavily docs list Bootstrap at 15,000 credits for $100/month, and the 2026 comparison sites agree on that figure. Project is 4,000 credits for $30, Bootstrap is 15,000 for $100 at $0.0067 per credit, Startup is 38,000 for $220 at $0.0058, and Growth is 100,000 for $500 at $0.005. Pay-as-you-go is $0.008 per credit, and the free tier gives 1,000 API credits every month with no card required.

Some third-party pages conflict with this. CostBench lists a "Researcher" tier at $30/month and "Startup" at $100/month, which doesn't match the official naming or prices (Plans: Free Research (free), Researcher at $30/month, and Startup at $100/month.). I'd treat the official docs table as authoritative.

Overage on a plan is billed at the pay-as-you-go rate rather than cutting off access, according to a ColdIQ analysis (once you're on a plan and blow past your monthly credits, Tavily bills the overage at that $0.008 per-credit rate rather than cutting you off.). A basic search costs 1 credit and an advanced search costs 2 (a basic search is 1 credit, an advanced search 2 credits).

content.text:
For about 15k searches a month, you'd want Tavily's **Bootstrap plan: $100/month for 15,000 credits**. That works out to about $0.0067 per credit.

**Credits and searches**
- A basic search costs 1 credit and an advanced search costs 2.
- 15k basic searches fit exactly in Bootstrap, with no headroom.
- If any of your searches are advanced, you'd go over 15,000 credits. Overage on a plan is billed at the pay-as-you-go rate of $0.008 per credit, according to one third-party analysis (ColdIQ), not Tavily's own pages.

**Alternatives**

| Option | Price | Credits | Verdict for 15k |
|---|---|---|---|
| Pay As You Go | $0.008 per credit | none included | About $120 for 15k credits, so costlier than Bootstrap |
| Project | $30/month | 4,000 | Too small |
| Startup | $220/month | 38,000 | Only if you expect more than 15k, or lots of advanced searches |
| Growth | $500/month | 100,000 | Much larger than you need |

**Sources disagree on plans.** Tavily's pricing page, when I fetched it, listed only Researcher (free, 1,000 credits), Pay As You Go, Project ($30, 4,000 credits) and Enterprise. It didn't show Bootstrap. The Bootstrap, Startup and Growth figures come from search results that cite Tavily's docs and comparison sites, and some third-party pages use different plan names and prices. Check the live pricing page before you commit.

Sources:
- [Tavily pricing](https://www.tavily.com/pricing)
- [Tavily help: pricing](https://help.tavily.com/articles/8816424538-pricing)
- [Tavily API credits docs](https://docs.tavily.com/documentation/api-credits.md)
- [ColdIQ: Tavily pricing](https://coldiq.com/blog/tavily-pricing)
